audience: sales teams that keep accounts, contacts, deals and tasks in Salesflare

useCases.title: Review the open deals of a pipeline
useCases.text: List the pipelines and their stages. Then list open opportunities by pipeline, stage or owner, with their value and close date.

useCases.title: Find a contact and review its account
useCases.text: Search contacts by email or name. Open the contact, then its account and the tasks of that account.

useCases.title: Add a new contact to an account
useCases.text: Find the account first, then create a contact that is linked to that account.

useCases.title: Move a deal to another stage
useCases.text: List the stages of the pipeline, then update the deal with the new stage. Only the fields you pass change.

useCases.title: Set a follow-up task for an account
useCases.text: List the users to find the owner's id. Then create a task for the account and assign it to that user.
